title: A sprint whose items mostly edit one skill is split by section at planning, not run one after another
goal: SP-qg7ncs6d had kb-sprint/SKILL.md and AGENTS.md in the touches of 6 of its 8 items; start warned that they run one after another, and all seven stories ran serially, one headless worker at a time, though most edited separate sections. Planning step 5 says to split such edits by section or order them; the triage that planned the sprint did neither. Plan names, for a file in more than half of a sprint's items, the section each item edits, so items on separate sections of a skill can run in parallel (a section-level touch, or items merged into one), or records why they stay serial. Found at the SP-qg7ncs6d close.

run: import sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();ok='stay serial' in t;print('plan records why same-file items stay serial:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
